{{Quote|Commander Stratus. One of our patrols has spotted a Republic convoy moving towards Cobalt Station. I'd like a permission to attack.|Colonel Mazzi|<ref name="Republic 56">[[Republic 56|''Republic'' 56]]</ref>}}
'''Mazzi''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] who served in the [[Nimbus commando]]s of the [[Nationalist Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Together with numerous officers that served within the [[Jabiimi Nationalists]], Mazzi served in the rank of [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Nationalist Army]] and commanded many [[Nimbus commando]]s during the [[Battle of Jabiim]] against the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Jabiimi Loyalists]]. In doing so, he was directly under the command of [[Alto Stratus]] and was usually in his immediate vicinity. After Alto was killed by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Mazzi, who was the highest ranking of the commando, gathered the remaining survivors of the Nimbus commandos around him and fought further against the Loyalists after the Republic had to withdraw from the planet.<ref name="GaW" />

After the Clone Wars had come to an end and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] establishing the first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Mazzi and the Jabiimi Nationalists allied themselves with the newly established government, and were allowed to proceed against the rebellious loyalists at their own discretion.<ref name="GaW" />
